name: Nightlist
summary: Overnight lung cancer trial screening for a community clinic: the model compiles public trial eligibility text into checks, and Zetaris runs them over patient data the model never sees.

meterless.nightshift: primary AI provider; routing modes meterless/deep and meterless/fast

sponsor_technology.nvidia: Nemotron models behind Nightshift: a large model compiles criteria, a small one back-translates them

data.patients: 240 synthetic patients, no real patient data
